|game_text=If Obi-Wan is out of play, use 1 Force to deploy on table. During battle, may use 1 Force to add 5 to your total power there for remainder of turn. Once per turn, if [[Luke (V){{!}}Luke]] a captive, may activate 1 Force. (Immune to [[Control]].)
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[I Can't Believe He's Gone (V) (Virtual Block 1)]]; it is the current text. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB1-127-I_Can_t_Believe_He_s_Gone-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 8 November 2026). The Virtual Block 1 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB1-127-I_Can_t_Believe_He_s_Gone.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB1-L-icantbelievehesgone-pre.gif]]) show the original text; see [[I Can't Believe He's Gone (V) (Virtual Block 1)]].
* '''Original''' ([[I Can't Believe He's Gone (V) (Virtual Block 1)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 1 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “If Obi-Wan is out of play (and not on table), use 1 Force to deploy on table. During battle, may use 1 Force to add 5 to your total power there for remainder of turn. Once per turn, if Luke a captive, may activate 1 Force. (Immune to Control.)”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Virtual Block 1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020181626/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again. That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[I Can't Believe He's Gone (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text) changed “play (and not on table),” to “play,”. PC-E1 text: “If Obi-Wan is out of play, use 1 Force to deploy on table. During battle, may use 1 Force to add 5 to your total power there for remainder of turn. Once per turn, if Luke a captive, may activate 1 Force. (Immune to Control.)”<ref name="cl-1210_127-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock1Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
